title: billing-api hosts disk full from un-rotated audit logs
summary: Two billing-api hosts ran out of disk because logrotate was removed from the AMI in a hardening change. Audit log writes failed with 'No space left on device', causing transactional writes to roll back as 500s. Symptoms identical to INC-2026-0005.
resolution: Truncated the open log file to free space, restored logrotate via configuration management, and re-baked the AMI with logrotate included by default.
follow_ups: AMI smoke test: logrotate present and ran in last 24h (DONE)
Ship audit logs to S3 via Fluent Bit (DONE)
